title: Lint rule change buried in repeated build/lint output lines
notes: Long runs of near-identical lint/build output bury one real decision (disabling a noisy lint rule). Tests junk resistance and whether the extractor still finds the one real decision.

342 problems (0 errors, 342 warnings)
342 warnings, all no-console, no errors. That's a lot of noise for something that's mostly intentional debug logging in CLI-facing utils.
Yeah, most of those console.log calls are deliberate CLI output, not debug leftovers. Can we just turn off no-console for the CLI utils folder specifically, but keep it on elsewhere?

Good idea — I'll add an eslint overrides block scoped to src/cli/**/*.ts and src/utils/**/*.ts that disables no-console, while leaving it enabled (as a warning) everywhere else in the repo. That should drop the 342 warnings down to near zero without silencing console usage in application code where it's more likely to be a leftover debug statement.
Do it and re-run to confirm.
Added the overrides block and re-ran eslint . — down to 6 warnings total, all outside the CLI/utils scope and worth a look separately.

gold_atoms.text: The initial lint run reported 342 warnings, all no-console, with 0 errors, mostly from deliberate console.log calls in CLI-facing utils.
Add an eslint overrides block that disables the no-console rule for src/cli/**/*.ts and src/utils/**/*.ts, while keeping it enabled as a warning everywhere else in the repo.
After adding the eslint override, re-running eslint . dropped warnings from 342 to 6, all outside the CLI/utils scope.
